<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors where one value is twice the other. The measured total resistance between terminals A and X1 is 6.667 Ω. Assuming a series connection (the simplest interpretation of “left‑to‑right” labeling), the series sum R + 2R = 3R must equal 6.667 Ω, giving R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. This matches the measurement within rounding error, so the topology is a series chain of two resistors. I will represent the intermediate node as N1.</thought>
